# Native JPEG scan controls

Generated by unmodified libjxl v0.12.0 a7a9c78, effort 3, lossless JPEG mode.
Original JPEGs independently specify all entropy bits for two zero-coefficient
grayscale blocks at 16x8. Suffix digits mean progressive, extra ZRL and zero
padding. Native reconstruction is exact for every original; decoded source
samples are uniformly 128 in an independent JPEG decoder.

Expanded controls are generated by `scripts/jpeg_scan_native_controls.py`.
They include nonzero AC before/after ZRL, 1–3 runs, a run finishing the block
without EOB, long Huffman codes, gray absolute sampling, restart boundaries
and interleaved 4:4:4/odd 4:2:0 grids. Each source is independently rendered
and reconstructed exactly with pinned native v0.12 before text conversion.
